Largest Countries in the World (by area)

The largest country in the world is Russia, with a total area of 17,098,242 km² (6,601,668 mi²) and a land area of 16,377,742 km² (6,323,482 mi²), equal to 12.4% of the world's land area of 131,847,584 km² (50,906,637 mi², excluding Antarctica).
